notes: "Stable identity lets the history stay with the page. I can inspect its operations to see what changed, and save a named version at a meaningful stage for later review or restore. These are real page versions saved in this project. This is my response to the full-deck copy problem: keep working in one project, with the history attached to the page being changed."

designIntent.purpose: Stable identity lets the history stay with the page.
keep: Keep source figures, labels, measured values and citations
Keep intentional background roles, product identity and meaningful density
